+package main
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+
+	lua "github.com/yuin/gopher-lua"
+)
+
+// ExecutePricingScript executes a user-provided Lua script to calculate final price
+func ExecutePricingScript(script string, ctx map[string]float64) (float64, error) {
+	L := lua.NewState()
+	defer L.Close()
+
+	// Convert the context map to a Lua table
+	ctxTable := L.NewTable()
+	for key, value := range ctx {
+		L.SetField(ctxTable, key, lua.LNumber(value))
+	}
+
+	// Execute the Lua script to define the function
+	if err := L.DoString(script); err != nil {
+		return 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to execute script: %w", err)
+	}
+
+	// Get the calculate_final_price function
+	calcFunc := L.GetGlobal("calculate_final_price")
+	if calcFunc == lua.LNil {
+		return 0, fmt.Errorf("calculate_final_price function not found in script")
+	}
+
+	// Call the function with the context table
+	if err := L.CallByParam(lua.P{
+		Fn:      calcFunc,
+		NRet:    1,
+		Protect: true,
+	}, ctxTable); err != nil {
+		return 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to call calculate_final_price: %w", err)
+	}
+
+	// Get the return value
+	ret := L.Get(-1)
+	L.Pop(1)
+
+	// Convert the return value to float64
+	if num, ok := ret.(lua.LNumber); ok {
+		return float64(num), nil
+	}
+
+	return 0, fmt.Errorf("calculate_final_price must return a number, got %s", ret.Type())
+}
+
+func main() {
+	// Example usage
+	script := `
+function calculate_final_price(ctx)
+    -- Apply 10% discount for VIP users (tier 2)
+    if ctx.user_tier >= 2 then
+        return ctx.base_price * 0.9
+    else
+        return ctx.base_price
+    end
+end
+`
+
+	ctx := map[string]float64{
+		"base_price": 100.0,
+		"user_tier":  2,
+	}
+
+	price, err := ExecutePricingScript(script, ctx)
+	if err != nil {
+		fmt.Printf("Error: %v\n", err)
+		return
+	}
+
+	fmt.Printf("Final price: %.2f\n", price)
+}

+package main
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+
+	lua "github.com/yuin/gopher-lua"
+)
+
+func ExecutePricingScript(script string, ctx map[string]float64) (float64, error) {
+	L := lua.NewState()
+	defer L.Close()
+
+	// Execute the script to define calculate_final_price
+	if err := L.DoString(script); err != nil {
+		return 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to execute script: %w", err)
+	}
+
+	// Build the context table
+	table := L.NewTable()
+	for k, v := range ctx {
+		table.RawSetString(k, lua.LNumber(v))
+	}
+
+	// Call calculate_final_price with the context table
+	if err := L.CallByParam(lua.P{
+		Fn:      L.GetGlobal("calculate_final_price"),
+		NRet:    1,
+		Protect: true,
+	}, table); err != nil {
+		return 0, fmt.Errorf("failed to call calculate_final_price: %w", err)
+	}
+
+	// Get the return value
+	ret := L.Get(-1)
+	L.Pop(1)
+
+	num, ok := ret.(lua.LNumber)
+	if !ok {
+		return 0, fmt.Errorf("calculate_final_price did not return a number, got %s", ret.Type())
+	}
+
+	return float64(num), nil
+}
+
+func main() {
+	script := `
+function calculate_final_price(ctx)
+    if ctx.user_tier >= 2 then
+        return ctx.base_price * 0.9
+    else
+        return ctx.base_price
+    end
+end
+`
+	ctx := map[string]float64{
+		"base_price": 100,
+		"user_tier":  2,
+	}
+
+	price, err := ExecutePricingScript(script, ctx)
+	if err != nil {
+		fmt.Printf("Error: %v\n", err)
+		return
+	}
+	fmt.Printf("Final price: %.2f\n", price)
+}
